observation.visible_scene: A static view of a warehouse roller-conveyor system. A metal roller conveyor runs diagonally from the near left to the far right in the foreground; a blue curved conveyor sits to the left, and a parallel conveyor with railings and posts is in the background. A green plastic bin (with a '3M' marking and a barcode label) and cardboard boxes travel along the foreground line, while a small cardboard box is present on the background line at upper right.
visible_changes: A green bin enters the left edge around t=0.08 s and moves rightward along the foreground roller conveyor, receding into the distance, reaching the far right and leaving view by about t=1.5 s.

A cardboard box enters the foreground left around t=1.5 s and travels rightward along the same conveyor; by t=3.0–3.2 s it is at left-center showing a '3M' logo, and its motion is still ongoing at the clip end.
A cardboard box is visible on the parallel background conveyor at upper right throughout the excerpt, with only modest apparent shifts in position along that line.
The background structure (blue curved conveyor, vertical posts, railings) stays fixed in the frame, indicating the camera is stationary.
Black segmented transfer/guide elements along the right edge of the foreground conveyor change position from frame to frame.
outside_clip_unknowns: Where the green bin and the cardboard boxes originate or are headed.
What occurs before t=0 and after t=3.2 s.
Whether the background box is independently moving or stationary on its own line.
uncertain_details: Whether the foreground cardboard box seen in the second half is the same object as the one on the background line or a successive item.
The exact function and motion of the black segmented elements on the conveyor edge.
Precise direction of the background box's small apparent position changes.
